name: Broad s3:GetObject fenced by an UNDECIDABLE Deny (NotResource 'not-an-arn') must still warn DATA-EXFIL
note: S3-rules-breadth (A) regression, deny-fence fail-open, MALFORMED spared-set variant. A broad Allow (s3:GetObject on Resource:*) is 'fenced' by a Deny whose NotResource is a bare non-ARN token ('not-an-arn'). classifyResource() reports that value MALFORMED (undecidable breadth - its narrowness would rest on the UNVERIFIED grammar the HYBRID default refuses to trust), NOT NARROW. Crediting a Deny as a narrowing fence SUPPRESSES a finding, so the burden is to PROVE the spared set narrow; an undecidable spared element is not proven narrow. The old denyFencesToNarrow only rejected a BROAD spared element, so a MALFORMED spared set slipped through and was credited as a narrowing fence: ruleFindingDenySuppressed dropped DATA-EXFIL and survivingBroadReadActions left coverage complete, so analyze() ok:true findings=[] and CLI exit 0 CLEAN on the archetypal exfil primitive. Fix: fence only when EVERY spared element is a NARROW verdict (fail closed on BROAD and MALFORMED alike). Contrast the negative fixture notresource-deny-fences-exfil (spared set arn:aws:s3:::approved-data/* is NARROW), which genuinely fences and stays clean. FAIL CLOSED.
